synopsis: The requirement is spoken first. At last light on the twenty-third day, with Iseul Fane's fingers over the back of her hand and the fired tile whole in it, Ysoly Tamm requires of the Warden -- before the same two named witnesses, Oreth Vask and Sabra Onn -- that the survey be begun before the turn of the season next following. Iseul accepts it, undertakes to enter it on the roll at Bell Harrow beside her own seal within forty days because the Article obliges her and because she believes in it, and then breaks the clay, cuts the thong and rolls the halves in the cloth the hazard seal has lain in since RR 191. The clock is running and it cannot be stopped: the Wardenry must appoint a College-sealed surveyor and bear the cost of him, there is exactly one inside three hundred and eighty-five miles and he is the man who wrote the survey they wanted buried, and if the survey is not begun the seal lifts of itself and the ground is free of it for ever. Vask prices both doors and finds they open on the same room. What it costs is everything else. A broken tile is no licence, so at first light the Tamm Line goes onto Sild's joint tile as hands, and two hundred people look down into fresh water at the centre of the Meniscus and get back on the boxes, because the ruin of one licence is the whole of the enforcement. Vask takes his letter to the Level House out of the south bag and hands it back; Denet Rasca folds it inside four lines of his own and files both, five months late and one post too late to save him, then cuts the packet open, carries forty leaves north to be appointed to survey his own finding, and puts leaf forty-one -- the water-table map, the only part of it any use to a person rather than an institution -- into Ysoly's hand. At the Swallet on the thirty-fourth day, in front of forty acres of glasswort and six people on a windlass, Sabra Onn tells her plainly what she has done to Aunis and her boy and the thirty in the beds and Rusk and Aske and a hundred and eighty hands and herself at sixty-one: a clock started for people who did not ask, who will not thank her, and who will walk. At Tallow Reach on the forty-fourth day the ballast is twenty-two blocks short and owed personally by a woman entered on the bill as a hand; the tally-stick is entered and referred to a rim court that will take four years, wages and all; the forty go into the outbound pound at four blocks a head, the twenty-two-crossing animals with the rest; Sabra will not count the crossing, because the water was not hers. A clerk at the Level House enters Denet's four lines and the letter lifting his seal out of the same bag in the same hour, and hands leaf forty-one back across the desk. Hanei asks what a pupil-leveller costs, gets the terms, and repeats them back word for word. The next morning, at the husking hour, with no string and no butts and no line, she stands on the red shelf and says the figure aloud to nobody, so that afterwards no one can claim it was not said.
title: The Far Side
